messages.author: aa17a960edc5c28f
messages.subject: spreadsheet data format
parts:
Hi all, I will fit a dynamic occupancy model to a dataset of repeated visits (presence/absence) to the same sites over several years. I have covariates. I´m figuring out how to build the Excel spreadsheet to digitalize the field data. I wonder if somebody here can provide some guidance or indicate an example that I can use as a template.  

Thanks in advance.

joaquín

messages.author: 00ebeb6e0521112d
messages.subject: Re: spreadsheet data format
parts:
Dear Joaquin,

there are many different possible formats to put your data into. I'd put them in a site by (year & visit) format, as shown in the attached file for a simulated toy data set with 4 sites, 2 years and a maximum of 4 visits per site. This is the format required for the colext() function in unmarked and it's also easy to work with it when using a general model-fitting engine such as JAGS or NIMBLE (although there I'd then put the detection/nondetection data into a 3D array with dimensions site x visit x year).

Best regards  --- Marc

parts:

I have for each site and year, habitat variables that do not vary between visits in the same year, but also climatic variables such as wind speed, that might vary between visits within a year. 

Best,
joaquin
